root.description: The id of the root the path is under

config.description: The demanded config the compilation is of, relative to its root

path.description: A file of the config's program closure within git content, relative to its root

distance.description: 0 for the config's own root files (`tsconfig_files`); else the length of the shortest chain of `file` targets from one

reachedOnly.description: Whether the file is reached through a reference and is not one of the config's root files

projection-ts-program-files.description: A row of the derived `ts_program_files` relation: the files a demanded config's compilation reaches within git content, not a runtime claim
